en.title: Hampton under local state of emergency due to nor'easter damage
en.dek: A nor'easter caused storm damage leading to a local state of emergency in Hampton according to 13newsnow.com.
facts: Hampton is under a local state of emergency.
A nor'easter caused storm damage in Hampton.
13newsnow.com reported this on 27 November 2026.
body: 13newsnow.com reported that Hampton is under a local state of emergency on 27 November 2026.
A nor'easter caused storm damage in Hampton.

北東の嵐がハンプトンで嵐による被害を引き起こした

北東の嵐がハンプトンに風水害をもたらしました。
